newsitem.title: MOZAMBIQUE: British couple murdered on Mozambique highway.
newsitem.headline: British couple murdered on Mozambique highway.

text.p: Two British teachers were shot dead by armed bandits on a highway in Mozambique this week, a British High Commission official in Maputo said on Friday.
Mozambique police said the killing took place on Sunday but that the bodies of the married couple were only found on Thursday.
The High Commission official said the couple were resident in neighbouring Malawi but declined to release their names until their next of kin had been notified.

Police said the couple were stopped by armed bandits on the main highway which runs through Mozambique's Tete province to Malawi. They were returning to Malawi's administrative capital Lilongwe where they both taught, after a visit to Zimbabwe.
The couple were pulled from the car and shot near the Malawi border. The gunmen fled with their car and possessions but later abandoned the vehicle after it overturned.
The High Commission official said arrangements were being made to fly the bodies home to Britain.
